note: The sites the live blocking suite measures (docs/probehost/02-runner.md section 3). Data only: no code reads a URL from anywhere else, and ProbeHost never reads this file - the runner copies the one scenario it is about to run into the app container. Every entry must be legal, mainstream and safe: no piracy, adult or malware hosts. Adding a site is a review item, which is why the list lives in one data file.

scenarios.title: Harness self-check (offline fixture)
scenarios.notes: Served by the app's own listener on 127.0.0.1. No network. Its failure aborts the suite. It gets the same 45s timeout as a live page even though it is local: a fresh app launch applies every compiled rule list to its first navigation, which took 25s for 17 lists on a CI runner, and a shorter budget classified the page before it had committed and made the gate abstain. Only #ad-slot is a DOM selector: the fixture keeps #content visible on purpose as proof the page rendered, and domVisibleMax counts every selector in this list, so listing #content here would fail the gate by design. The allowed side is proved by expect.allowedMustLoad plus the run.json fixture block.
